title: Sentient Amulet (Very Rare)

sources.title: Help the Spirit of the Amulet

summary: Amulet casts Shatter and restores Ki.

fields.Shatter: Level 3, despite the level 2 tooltip. Action, 60 ft range, 10 ft radius. Deals 4d8 Thunder, Constitution save for half. Inorganic targets save with Disadvantage. Recharges on a Long Rest.
fields.Ki Restoration: Action on yourself once per Long Rest. Restores a roll of your Martial Arts die in Ki Points, such as 1d8 for a level 9 Monk.
fields.Acquisition: Refuse the cursed monk’s madness and defeat him during Help the Cursed Monk. This version casts Shatter without the Wisdom backlash.
fields.Base value: 210 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
